The entire page is editorial application material — the parable serves to explain the ecclesial practice of intercessory prayer that follows. No cosmic-realm correspondence; one side of every mapping reaches into the editor's contemporary church world (catechumens, household-members, the holy church, beseeching, remembrance). Strong editorial fatigue (+0.51) confirms institutional drift in the second half (ecclesial vocabulary 5.0→8.8).
